instrument.name: Modified Rankin Scale
instrument.purpose: global disability/dependence outcome, especially after stroke

rmd.interpretation: global degree of disability or dependence

eprovide.conditions: The questionnaire is in the public domain.
eprovide.review_copy_warning: Do not treat ePROVIDE review-copy formatting or structured/training materials as the public-domain instrument itself.

methodology.reference: van Swieten JC et al. Interobserver agreement for the assessment of handicap in stroke patients. Stroke. 1988.
methodology.interrater_issue: Reliability depends on consistent interviewing, training and interpretation of global functional dependence.
methodology.dichotomization: Trial/research protocols may define favorable outcome using different cut points; Rawafid does not impose a universal clinical dichotomy.

arabic.next_action: If a validated Arabic mRS or structured mRS version with clear rights becomes available, add it as a separately versioned form rather than silently replacing the operational rendering.
